boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 59 starts as a double-chamber board but finishes as a lock puzzle. Open the big central `4` chamber first, thin the lower-left `10` room second, and then use the freed middle to break the chain column before you cash the large pink block on the right.
landmarks: Block Out Level 59 starts as a double-chamber board but finishes as a lock puzzle.
Open the big central `4` chamber first, thin the lower-left `10` room second, and then use the freed middle to break the chain column before you cash the large pink block on the right.
The board mixes Purple, Blue, Orange and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: The chained center spine is the real late-game gate, not the big pink block.
Open the central `4` room before you spend serious effort on the lower-left `10` chamber.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Drain the big central purple chamber marked `4` before you overwork the lower-left `10` room.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Trim the upper shelf while that chamber is shrinking so the middle lane is not boxed in by the side walls.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Start reducing the lower-left `10` chamber only after the center `4` room has already opened some floor space.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: When the chained padlock column appears, clear that center spine before moving the large pink block on the right.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Use the unlocked middle to slide the pink block and nearby red pieces toward the lower exits.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish with the bottom yellow cluster and the last small side pieces after the chain lane is empty.

failurePoints: Treating the lower-left `10` chamber like the opener while the central `4` room is still filling the board.
Trying to move the large pink block before the chained center column has been cleared.
